analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 44.0 to 52.4, signaling an exit from oversold territory, and the MACD histogram shows improvement. However, the current price is -2.83% below the SMA200, indicating weakness, and the weekly RSI at 46.5 remains in neutral territory, lacking conviction for a trend reversal. Volume ratio at 1.19 for 5 consecutive days is normal. The 52-week position is 8.5%, near the low.

· 52주 위치(8.5%) + 현 가격대 역사적 의미: 52주 저가($0.07) 대비 높은 수준이나 고가($0.27) 대비 현저히 낮은 위치

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0012→-0.0003) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 여부: 약세에서 벗어나며 바닥 다지기 신호
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $0.09/중단 $0.09/하단 $0.08) + 밴드폭 수준 해석: 중단 부근 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 구간
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.08) + 근거: SMA50, SMA100, EMA50, EMA20, 피벗 S1, 볼린저 하단 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.09) + 돌파 시 의미: SMA20, SMA200, 피벗 R1, 볼린저 중단/상단 기반, 돌파 시 단기 강세 전환 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 해석: 5일 고가/저가와 20일 고가/저가가 동일하여 뚜렷한 추세 없이 횡보 구간 확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.19배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 판단: 5일 평균 대비 정상 수준으로 움직임의 신뢰도 보통
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 진입·관망 조건 명시: RSI 과매도 탈출 및 MACD 개선 신호는 긍정적이나, 주봉 지표 및 SMA200 대비 위치 약세로 추세 전환 확신 부족. 0.09 저항선 돌파 여부 확인 후 진입 고려.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($0.09) vs SMA5($0.08)/SMA20($0.09)/SMA50($0.08): Short- to mid-term trend position diagnosis: Above SMA5, SMA50, at the same level as SMA20
· Position vs SMA100($0.08)/SMA200($0.09): Mid- to long-term trend strength assessment: Above SMA100, at the same level as SMA200
· 52-week position (8.5%) + Historical significance of current price range: Higher than 52-week low ($0.07) but significantly lower than 52-week high ($0.27)
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.0→52.4) + Exiting oversold + Directional interpretation: Moving out of oversold territory, suggesting potential for a rebound
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0012→-0.0003) + Improvement diagnosis + Trend reversal signal: Emerging from weakness, signaling bottoming action
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.09/Middle $0.09/Lower $0.08) + Bandwidth level interpretation: Sideways movement near the middle band, indicating a price discovery phase
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.08) + Basis: Based on SMA50, SMA100, EMA50, EMA20, Pivot S1, Bollinger Lower Band
· Swing Resistance ($0.09) + Significance of breakout: Based on SMA20, SMA200, Pivot R1, Bollinger Middle/Upper Band; a breakout could signal a short-term bullish reversal
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) + Trend interpretation: Identical 5-day and 20-day highs/lows confirm a sideways trend without a clear direction
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.19x) + Confidence level of movement: Normal level compared to the 5-day average, indicating moderate confidence in the movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Entry/Wait-and-see conditions: Positive signals from RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement, but weakness in weekly indicators and price relative to SMA200 lack conviction for a trend reversal. Consider entry after observing a breakout above the $0.09 resistance.
